title: Release-pinned peer capability and preservation limits
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local plan crosswalk; plan-only
scope: Refresh ACadSharp's current released artifact and distinguish it from mutable master and an open, undeployed ACIS writer proposal.
Reconcile the direction of the ACadSharp modeler writer change with a reported DXF-writer omission.
Review how LibreDWG documents unknown-class preservation and how ezdxf separates unknown-tag retention, recovery, and limited ACIS parsing.
Refine the existing optional composed comparison gate without adding a peer runtime or external fixture to the implementation loop.

sources.revision: Release, issue, and PR pages reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: v3.8.0 is the latest release shown, signed at 3a1c66b on 2026-09-21; its release notes list #1132 and do not list the ACIS writer work. The release page reports 180 commits to master since that tag. PR #1240 remains open and undeployed; its visible ModelerGeometry serialization change targets DwgObjectWriter. Issue #1195 reports DXF-writer omission against 3.4.9. These facts do not establish the current released DXF writer's behavior.

sources.revision: Mutable manual and repository documentation reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The manual says not all dynamic classes are supported; unstable classes can be converted to UNKNOWN or placeholder-like representations on write. Exact same-class preservation depends on a same-version rewrite with the complete unknown-bits blob. Project-level reader coverage and version-specific writer limitations do not establish per-object semantic support.

Unsupported DXF entities can be held as TagStorage for export. Recovery is a separate ASCII repair path that may tolerate decoding errors and warns that save-back can lose data or create invalid DXF. The ACIS API documents limited entity support and data loss for unsupported NONE_ENTITY structures.

planChanges: Treat ACadSharp v3.8.0 as the latest released candidate found in this review, not as evidence that the ACadSharp 3.4.9 DXF omission either persists or is fixed.
Keep the open, undeployed PR #1240's DWG writer work separate from DXF-writer claims and from ACIS semantic support.
For an optional exact 3DSOLID/REGION DXF output comparison, account for source identity, owner/block membership, raw carrier digest, emitted record, strict reopen, and loss disposition.
Use ordinary strict DXF read before any ezdxf recovery path; treat recovery/audit changes and unsupported ACIS nodes as explicit diagnostic/loss outcomes.
Keep peer/native execution outside per-slice implementation validation; missing external artifacts do not block local work.
limitations: Research was based on public documentation, release notes, issue and PR pages; no peer source tree or runtime was inspected or executed.
No behavior of ACadSharp v3.8.0, mutable master, or the open PR was independently reproduced.
Peer issue reports and project documentation are route-specific and are not authoritative DWG/DXF field-layout sources.
No local test command was run because this pass made only plan and receipt changes.
